replicate_statements: Representative ex vivo images of lungs from SNL mice, control (no Cre) or infected with Ad-Cre (11 months post infection), 24 h post injection with PDBA ICG 5.3 ultra pH-sensitive (UPS) nanoparticle.
(control n = 5 mice; Ad-Cre n = 3 mice, biological replicates)
outputs.replicate_type: biological replicates (mice); n stated in panel B for the same imaged mice
outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative images of the same lungs whose ICG fluorescence is quantified in Panel B, where the caption explicitly states n = 5 control mice and n = 3 Ad-Cre mice as biological replicates. The replicate number and type for this experiment are therefore reported in the shared legend, even though not repeated verbatim under panel A.

replicate_statements: Quantification of mean ICG fluorescence intensity (control n = 5 mice; Ad-Cre n = 3 mice, biological replicates). Unpaired t test with Welch's correction was used for the analysis, P = 0.0281.
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states the number of mice per group (n = 5 control, n = 3 Ad-Cre) and identifies them as biological replicates, satisfying replication reporting requirements for this quantitative bar/point plot with statistics.

replicate_statements: H&E image of the lung section from Fig. 3A), with ICG signal on the same section, and RNAscope of Tmprss11b (red) on a serial section.
outputs.explanation: Panel C explicitly refers to one specific lung section (the same section shown in Fig. 3A and a serial section from it), presented as a single illustrative case rather than a summary of replicated observations. No claim of representativeness across multiple samples is made, so replicate reporting is not required here.

replicate_statements: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) of immune cell pathways from the low pH versus high pH spatial transcriptomics data with normalized enrichment scores (NES), false discovery rate (FDR) and p values for the indicated gene signatures.
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations.
outputs.explanation: The GSEA compares low pH versus high pH regions derived from spatial transcriptomics data, but the caption never states how many tissue sections, mice, or spatial spots/regions underlie the low-pH and high-pH groups being compared. Only the number of statistical permutations (1000) used for computing significance is given, which is a resampling parameter, not a report of biological or technical replicates.

replicate_statements: Bar graph representing top M2-like/TAM genes from the differential gene expression (DEG) analysis of low pH versus high pH spatial transcriptomics data.

Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat's FindAllMarkers function, and direct comparisons between two classes and corresponding P values were obtained using Seurat's FindMarkers function with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: This bar graph presents log2 fold-change and p values comparing low pH versus high pH spatial transcriptomics regions, but the caption does not state how many tissue sections/mice or how many spots/observations per class were used to generate the differential expression statistics, so the number and type of replicates underlying this comparison are not reported.

replicate_statements: The staining was repeated with lung sections from different mice (n = 2, biological replicates).
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states that IHC staining was repeated in lung sections from n = 2 different mice, identified as biological replicates. This is a qualitative representative-image panel rather than a quantitative summary/statistical panel, so the reporting is complete even though n = 2 is low.
